title: Mold Linker Version 3.0.0 Release – Rewritten in Rust
summary: Mold 3.0.0 is a major release of the ultra-fast linker, rewritten entirely in Rust from its previous implementation, offering significantly faster linking speeds compared to traditional linkers like GNU ld and LLVM lld.
problem_solved: Dramatically reduces linking time in large C/C++ projects to improve developer productivity during the build cycle.
why_valuable: Since linking occurs on every build, even small improvements compound into massive time savings for developers working on large codebases.
